postal_system.legal_rule: Myanmar Post provides the current seven-digit postcode lookup. The 2022 UPU sheet defines two digits for state, region or country, two for town or township, and three for Quarter or Village Tract, positioned after town or township. These establish syntax, address order and dated assignment evidence, not canonical polygons, exact civic addresses, building relations, complete history or blanket redistribution rights.
postal_system.assignment_rule: Every postcode is stored as a seven-character digit string with leading zeroes preserved. A production assignment requires an exact current Myanmar Post result with authority, locality or Quarter or Village Tract, validity, retrieval time, response schema and digest pinned. Five-digit legacy metadata, MIMU PCodes, equal names, post-office points, coordinates, administrative overlap and nearest features do not create a postcode assignment, postal area or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No reviewed canonical national Myanmar postcode polygon artifact is bundled. An official postal surface requires an exact postal-authority boundary artifact and seven-digit code relation with authority, edition, coverage, rights, CRS, topology and digest pinned. Joining an exact postcode assignment to a permitted Survey Department, One Map or MIMU administrative boundary is a source-composed administrative join surface, not a postal-authority polygon. Voronoi, interpolation and model surfaces remain derived and uncertainty-bearing; MIMU PCodes, map labels and OSM never become official postcode polygons.
postal_system.address_rule: Recipient, organization, building, room or unit, house number, street, Quarter or Village Tract, village, town or township, district, state, region or union territory, postal-service object and seven-digit postcode remain typed and validity-aware. Rural and P.O. Box formats mean street, house and Quarter or Village Tract are not universally present. A postcode, PCode, administrative row, coordinate or map label alone does not identify a recipient, owner, occupant, entrance, unit or exact legal civic address.
postal_system.building_rule: Exact building display requires an explicit rights-cleared civic-address identifier, separately permitted building geometry, and a provider-defined stable relation, common identifier or reviewed explicit crosswalk. YCDC forms or tax records are controlled local evidence; Survey Department, One Map, MIMU and OSM building containment, address strings, coordinate equality, proximity and nearest-building logic are candidates or validation evidence only and never establish an exact address-building relation.
postal_system.licence_rule: Myanmar Post, the National Portal, UPU, Survey Department, One Map, MIMU and YCDC pages are reference evidence until exact reuse terms are recorded. MIMU products are operational for humanitarian, development and peace work, prohibit sale or commercial use, and require special written permission for geospatial datasets. Viewing, searching, requesting, registering, paying or attributing never grants blanket row, map, address or building redistribution rights.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Recipients, senders, P.O. Box holders, postcode and shipping query records, phones, emails, identity data, households, residents, owners, occupants, tenants, property-tax records, land or building forms, cadastral records, access credentials, tracking records and private premises are excluded from public artifacts. Only explicitly public or licensed non-personal fields may enter a production pack.
